fusions.name: Closing Loop
fusions.desc: Deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Quarry's Tag
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 12 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Pack Cry
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
